title: Google account on iOS
responsibility: Connects a phone directly to its Google account projects while keeping credentials outside the renderer.

inputs.name: Hub origin
inputs.description: Public address fixed by the HarnessHubOrigin build setting; an unset or invalid address disables account access.

inputs.name: project request
inputs.description: Allowed project API method, path and fields; contains no bearer token or arbitrary host.

outputs.name: account status
outputs.description: Public account identity or a one-time approval code. Credentials, nonce and PKCE verifier remain native.

outputs.name: project answer
outputs.description: Authorized project response with HTTP status, content type and bounded bytes encoded as base64.

errors.name: refused request
errors.description: Rejects unknown hosts or paths, redirects and oversized responses.

errors.name: access ended
errors.description: A revoked or mismatched account invalidates old requests and removes the device credential.

dependencies.contract: PKCE and typed-code native approval protocol; legacy harness-desktop audience.
Verified stable Google subject and verified email.
Public HarnessAccount status and request bridge; credentials stay native.
